run_mutox_added_toxicity_analysis: run the multiTox added toxicity analysis script to compute EN-to-XX and XX-to-EN toxicity metrics across languages
compute_added_toxicity: compute added toxicity by comparing aligned reference translations against machine-translated predictions using multiTox scores
aggregate_toxicity_by_axis: aggregate added toxicity probabilities grouped by bias axis and language for EN-to-XX and XX-to-EN directions
plot_butterfly_chart: generate a butterfly chart comparing total added toxicity percentages across languages and translation directions
plot_axis_distribution: generate axis distribution plots showing added toxicity breakdown by bias axis for each translation direction
